name: ambient-builder
description: Talk about an idea; a coding agent builds it while you talk.

scripts.start: npm run build -w web && npm run start -w server
scripts.tunnel: npm run build -w web && npm run start -w server -- --tunnel
scripts.mock: npm run build -w web && AMBIENT_MOCK=1 npm run start -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.screens: npm run build && SCREENS=1 playwright test screens
